  intro a
  have h : Measurable (fun b : γ × γ => b.1) := by apply Measurable.fst
  have k : Measurable (fun b : γ × γ => b.2) := by apply Measurable.snd
  let κη : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α (γ × γ) := ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prod κ η
  have hk : ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κη := ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.IsFiniteKernel.prod κ η
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun a => (κ a).singularPart (η a)) :=
    ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.measurable_density_left κη hk h k
  exact hmeas
